senses.gloss: m., אַחַת f. (b. h.; v. next w., one. [Freq. represented by א׳.] Kidd. 50ᵇ, a. fr. בבת אחת simultaneously, v. בַּת III.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 3:3">Peah III, 3</cite> <he>המחליק מאחת יד וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בא׳</he>) he who takes out onions with a unity of hand, i.e. all of them for one purpose.
Ber. 61ᵇ, a. fr. על אחת כמה וכמה (abbr. עאכ״ו) how much against one, i.e. how much the more.—אחד … אחד both … as well as.
<cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 1:1">Tem. I, 1</cite> <he>א׳ האנשים וכ׳</he> both, men as well as women.
Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ top אחת זו ואחתֹ זו the one as well as the other; a. fr.—כְּאֶחָד, כְּאַחַת at the same time.
Yoma I, 7 והפג אחת and cool thyself for once, for a change, v. חֲדַת.—Pl. אֲחָדִים

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:20">Yalk. Gen. 62</cite> (ref. to <he>דברים אחדים</he> <cite ref="Genesis 11:1">Gen. XI, 1</cite>) they spoke words <he>על שני א׳</he> against two only ones (ref. to <he>אחד</he> <cite ref="Ezekiel 33:24">Ezek. XXXIII, 24</cite> a.

senses.gloss: (cmp. אֲחַד) closed up, mysterious. Gen. R. l. c. (Yalk. l. c. אֲחוּדִים v. next w.).
